CellPopulation.doc: A PointInstancer that authors primvars:bio:cell:id or applies BioCellAPI has bio:cell:id and bio:cell:type with the stated type, varying interpolation and one value per instance; tokens are in their allowed sets; ontology terms are CL:/NCIT: CURIEs or empty; bio:cell:id is unique. Bio-USD 0.2.0.

StageMetadata.doc: On a Bio-USD stage (bio:version in customLayerData, a cell population, or BioCellAPI applied; any other stage gets no finding): metersPerUnit must be 1e-06 (one stage unit is one micrometre), upAxis Y or Z, and the root layer's customLayerData must carry bio:version; BioCellAPI may be applied to a PointInstancer only; UsdProfiles claims, when present, must agree with the stage; a stage that names bio:version holds at least one cell population. Bio-USD 0.2.0.
